module_summary: Four-state Moore FSM with asynchronous reset following a fixed transition table on in; out decodes state D.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Holds states A-D; transitions follow the table on input in.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Decoded from state D; module's only output.

groups.name: table_fsm
groups.description: Next-state table logic on in; out asserted in state D.
